title: Revert Expense API test re-enablement and consolidated fixes
summary: Fully reverts the earlier commit from #12325 that re-enabled Expense API tests with consolidated fixes, after integration runs failed with HTTP 500 null-reference errors. The AL-Go clean test codeunit setting is removed, prior test exclusions and the auth helper are restored, and the related production and test changes are rolled back.
key_points: Full 21-file revert of commit 3f357d6c from PR #12325
enableCleanTestCodeunitExecution removed from AL-Go settings; later settings updates kept
Prior Expense API authentication helper and 51 Expense API exclusions restored; 193 temporary general API exclusions removed
Consolidated production changes in Travel Request Approval and the related test changes rolled back
Mitigates the failing Expense API tests but does not prove the underlying server-side defect is fixed
quote: Revert commit 3f357d6c93edab81eab2437909d8dab17637ba0d, merged through #12325, as requested following the failures in workflow run 37598783939.
